title: Place a library component with models and parameters
summary: Places a schematic library component, or one part of a multi-part component, at an exact location with PlaceLibraryComponent and its Key=Value parameter string, and reads the placed component back.
phrasings: place a component from a SchLib on a sheet
place part B of a multi-part component
add parameters when placing a component
place a symbol at given coordinates without clicking

commands.name: PlaceComponent
commands.description: Place a component from a .SchLib/.IntLib on the active sheet with PlacingFromDatabase=true, PCB footprint models (ModelTypeN/ModelNameN/LocationN) and hidden parameters (ParameterNameN/ParameterValueN/ParameterVisibleN); reports the call's result, the parameter string and the new components
commands.params: Lib=<full path to a .SchLib/.IntLib, or file name of an installed library; required>|LibRef=<component, default RES2>|Models=<footprint@pcblib path;...; optional>|Params=<Name=Value;...; default PartNumber=931H451;Value=100R;Power=1/4W;Tolerance=5%; empty = none>|X=<mils, default 1000>|Y=<mils, default 1000>|Interactive (menu only: no location, cursor placement)

commands.name: PlacePart
commands.description: Place one part of a multi-part component with PartID=<n>; reports the call's result and the new component with its CurrentPartID
commands.params: Lib=<full path to a .SchLib/.IntLib, or file name of an installed library; required>|LibRef=<component, default XC2S300E-6PQ208C>|PartID=<n, 1-based, default 2>|X=<mils, default 1000>|Y=<mils, default 1000>|Interactive (menu only)
